skills.name: edit-with-claude
skills.description: Full 10-step talking-head edit driven from Claude Code — project folder, rough cut, clean audio, pacing, motion graphics, captions, music, colour, final mix, export. Use when the user says "edit this video", "edit my video with claude", "run the full edit", or drops raw talking footage and wants a finished video.

skills.name: project-folder
skills.description: Create a dated, self-contained project folder for a new video and copy (never move) the raw footage into it. Use when the user starts a new edit, says "set up a project", "new video folder", or hands over raw clips with no workspace yet.

skills.name: rough-cut-pass
skills.description: Turn raw talking-head footage into a tight first cut by transcribing with word timings and cutting dead air, ums, repeats, false starts and retakes (keeping the last good take), then verifying by re-listening. Use when the user says "rough cut", "first cut", "keep my last good take", "remove the ums", "cut my retakes".
template_prompts: rough cut raw/<CLIP>, keep my last good take of every line
[optional] cold open with the line "<strongest line>"
[optional] only the good bits, <N> minutes tops

skills.name: clean-audio-pass
skills.description: Clean voice audio for social video — cut rumble, tame boxiness, add clarity, soften harsh S's, compress, and normalise to -14 LUFS — measuring before and after. Use when the user says "clean up the audio", "social loudness", "fix the sound", "remove hum/noise", or right after a rough cut transcript exists.
template_prompts: clean up the audio, social loudness
[variants] … podcast loudness (-16) | … no EQ, I like my voice as is | … my hum is 60 Hz

skills.name: pacing-punch-in
skills.description: Tighten the pacing of a rough cut — cut every pause over a threshold (default 0.3 s) with edges snapped to the voice — and add subtle punch-in zooms on chosen phrases. Use when the user says "tighten the pacing", "make it snappier", "cut pauses over X s", "punch in on …", "add a zoom-in on …".
template_prompts: tighten the pacing: cut pauses over 0.3 s, punch in on "<phrase 1>" and "<phrase 2>"

skills.name: motion-graphic
skills.description: Build an animated motion graphic (stat counter, title card, sticker pop, explainer beat) as a time-driven HTML scene, render it frame-exact to video (with alpha if needed), and composite it onto the edit at the right word. Use when the user says "make a motion graphic for …", "animate this stat", "add a graphic/sticker when I say …", "explainer graphics".
template_prompts: make a motion graphic for <stat>: <from> to <to>, <label>, keep it clean and on-brand
pop a <sticker idea> sticker top-right when I say "<word>"
corner timer showing <value> while I talk about <topic>

skills.name: brand-kit-graphics
skills.description: Pull a company's real brand (colours, font files, logo, card shapes) from its live website into a reusable kit, then restyle motion graphics to match — same graphic, the brand's exact fonts and colours. Use before any sponsored or client graphic, or when the user says "make it on-brand for <company>", "match their brand", "use <company>'s colours/fonts".
template_prompts: make the rough-cut graphic on-brand for <company> (<url>) — pull their colours and fonts from the live site

skills.name: captions
skills.description: Add word-by-word burned-in captions in a fixed personal style (Montserrat SemiBold, translucent box, spoken word highlighted, big yellow emphasis words popping beside the speaker), timed to the final cut. Use when the user says "add captions", "subtitles in my style", "word-by-word captions", "make key words pop".
template_prompts: add captions in my style: Montserrat SemiBold, translucent box, word-by-word, emphasis pops beside me on "<word1>", "<word2>"

skills.name: music-bed
skills.description: Lay a licensed music track under the voice so it never overpowers it — normalise the bed, sidechain-duck it whenever the speaker talks, loop/trim to length, and fade in/out. Use when the user says "add music", "lo-fi under my voice", "duck the music when I talk", "it should never overpower me".
template_prompts: music: <calm lo-fi | upbeat | cinematic> under the voice, it should never overpower me

skills.name: color-grade
skills.description: Colour-correct and grade talking-head footage with a measured 3D LUT — fix white balance, blacks and exposure, then match the look of a reference/inspo still while protecting skin tones. Use when the user says "fix the colour", "fix the basics: white balance, blacks, exposure", "match this look", "warm film look", "keep my skin natural", or pastes an inspo image.
template_prompts: fix the basics: white balance, blacks, exposure
[paste inspo] match this <warm film | clean bright | moody> look, keep my skin natural

skills.name: final-mix
skills.description: Final loudness pass on the finished edit — two-pass EBU R128 normalisation to -14 LUFS integrated, -1 dBTP true peak, LRA 11 — so it plays at the right level on YouTube, Instagram and TikTok. Use when the user says "final mix", "-14 LUFS", "normalise loudness", "make it broadcast-safe", or before export.
template_prompts: final mix: -14 LUFS, true peak -1 dB

skills.name: export-master
skills.description: Export the finished edit at the source's own settings (resolution, frame rate, HEVC 10-bit, AAC 48 kHz) into renders/, plus optional platform versions (9:16, H.264 for upload). Use when the user says "export", "export at source settings", "render the final", "make the upload file".
template_prompts: [optional] also make a 9:16 version and an H.264 upload copy
